title: Fused AMP clipping runs before GradScaler unscales gradients, making valid updates too small.
trigger: Actual ComposableTrainer with MixedPrecisionStepStrategy and GradientClippingOptimizerStrategy(DefaultOptimizerStrategy), registry SGD fused=True, real CPU torch.amp.GradScaler scale65536. Single scalar parameter1, loss10*w, lr.1,max_norm1. Same CPU scaler injection as author supported overflow qualification; no CUDA runtime claim.
expected: Clip unscaled gradient10 to10/(10+1e-6), producing weight0.900000009999999.

cause: Public optimizer step prehook sees scaled gradient655360 for AMP-aware fused SGD because GradScaler defers unscaling into optimizer internals. Wrapper clips it to~1, then fusedSGD divides by65536. NonfusedGradScaler unscales before invoking optimizer.step, so its control passes.
scope: Composition of newly corrected clipping wrapper and existing real AMP path. Not an objection to research math, optional packages or hardware availability.
acceptance: Original author makes public clipping consume unscaled gradients for fused and nonfused AMP, preserves actual overflow skip/count and accumulation-tail semantics, adds actual numerical parameter-reference regression on both versions; no broad warning suppression. Fresh review after fix.
limitations: CPU fused and nonfused numerical qualification only; public CUDA autocast disables itself on this host and emits the recorded warning. No CUDA claim. Source candidate remains frozen while independent reviewers run.
